author: reek
body: Stage 3 of the proof system: a definitional-equality normalizer. Before the propositional-equality check runs, each side of a value `===` is reduced by delta (unfold a function call to its body) and iota (reduce a when-match whose scrutinee is a constructor). So `flip On` reduces to `Off` (delta flip, then iota the match), and `id-bit On` reduces to `On` (delta). Each claim then checks by Refl against the reduced normal form. The negative guard lives in codex/test/errors/normalize-false.
